name: Input Directory
tip: Path to the root directory containing preprocessed .npy files.

name: Output Directory
tip: Path to the root directory where embeddings will be saved.

name: MOMENT Model ID
tip: HuggingFace model ID to be used for embedding generation.

name: Context Window
tip: Context window size for MOMENT (the number of time steps processed at once).

name: Overwrite Files
tip: If checked, existing embedding files will be replaced.
